summary: A funding pool aimed at promoting publicly accessible cultural events and activities throughout Frederikssund Municipality to support a vibrant cultural life.
eligible_applicants: Municipal cultural institutions in collaboration with volunteer associations
Self-governing institutions based in Frederikssund Municipality
activity_types: Extraordinary cultural events arranged with volunteer associations
reporting_requirements: Submission of an electronic application form via Frederikssund Municipality website
Applications reviewed by the Cultural Council before the process by the Leisure and Culture Committee
